title: Midlands Champs & YBT Heat
text:
Congratulations to all those who took part in the Midlands Championships on 28th February in Sherwood Forest and in particular to Matthew Clark, who won the M16 class. Rumour has it that success depends on the ability to differentiate live from dead oak trees at speed, even in winter! Individuals from EAOA, in addition to those from the East and West Midlands areas are eligible to compete in this event, which this year was hosted by NOC. A summary of the results can be found here.

Congratulations also to the Juniors who formed the SuffOC team at the Yvette Baker Trophy heat at Hockham on 6th March. The team was placed third overall, with Matthew Clarke and Barney Steventon-Barnes both winning their classes. Full results can be found here.
